title: Abandoned Theater in the Woods
description: A surreal night scene viewed through a broken, weathered wooden frame with peeling gold paint. Rows of empty wooden chairs stand in a grassy field under a glowing full moon, flanked by two ancient twisted trees connected by a tattered rope bridge with hanging fabric, while two glowing owls peer from the branches.
